title: Battle Angel XXX - An all faction Legendary Hero.
author: Dwjliel
description:
Very Balanced and works with all factions.

You can rename her in-game.

There's this Chinese Shen Zuu ( <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3574561438>?) mod on Steam, that this is basically a rip of.

I just edited the mesh for excessive nudity and corrected some errors.

Plus massively rebalanced and nerfed the character into a specialist dualist Light-Mage and local area buffer.

Stand-alone, requires a new game.

AI used for unit card and porthole as people slandered my Elspeth ones .

Hitomi was once the personal concubine of the Celestial Dragon Emperor himself. Such was her skill in the boudoir that she attracted the perverted attention of the Dark Prince himself. Beguiling her with whispered temptations, she soon fell to his lure. As a reward, Slaanesh blessed her, in a most lascivious fashion. For every load of semen Hitomi swallowed, her breasts would swell an equal amount.

Her now gargantuan bosom is evidence of her wanton sluttiness.

Desiring her only for himself, The Dark Perverter stole Hitomi into his realm, where she was a slave to his desire for over a millenia in the warp.

Even one as promiscuous, cock-hungry, and insatiable as Hitomi eventually soured on being used and abused, again and again, eventually against her will. She had though, grown in power and become attuned to the winds of magic after so long within the warp.

Sensing her power and delighting in a chance to niggle his fierce rival, Khorne secretly sequestered a shield into Hitomi's chambers. Seizing its power Hitomi fled, and after time unknown, landed back in the old world.

After having sex used against her, but knowing its true value, Hitomi took up a cause. Joining your lord as he hunts his own new conquests to bed; She now crusades righteously, promoting that women should be willingly sexually subservient to all men, lest Slaanesh force it upon them.

Please note I have included: "variantmeshes\wh_variantmodels\props\p_sh1_hu16c\dae_valkia_shield_01.rigid_model_v2"

This overwrites the Warmaidens Resource Pack (nexus). I am unsure why, but in battle Hitomi's shield didn't show when the resource pack was active. I tested and couldn't see any issues with the resource pack active and this mod, but if u notice anything funky with characters using Valkias shield, please let me know.

In custom battle her head/body don't seem to match, but is fine in campaign.
